folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B330: full pace report and later direction
folds.body:
All300 lines were content-reviewed: the attention/director/phase comparisons, fifteen comparison rows, three proposed settings, routine/offline/world defaults, active-decision principles, failure guards, P1–P8, Q1–Q5 and final source-status note. Preserve the evidence qualifications: several figures and summaries were secondary, snippet-only or memory; Melvor's24hour cap is explicitly unverified. The linked idle-survey PDF was not read by this review. No source statistics, complete game rules or present balance were verified here.

The later absence-owner user corrections qualify this report's fixed per-world pace defaults and few-hard-dates premise. Schedule and event content can make a life calm or busy without assigning its world a fixed category. Many relevant clocks can coexist; visible load does not change actual occurrence. The later uncapped/standing-order discussion and journey-wide eligible-unused-time direction qualify P7's blanket24hour cap and closed-tab assumptions. A newer paragraph is not blanket adoption of every proposed stale-rate penalty or economy-efficiency dial either.

The useful contract is a real routine, actual work/support/stock/time, meaningful stop and a truthful return account. A quiet or solved life can truthfully have no new event or decision for24hours; that is not automatically a defect requiring invented chores, hazards, rewards or social contact. A return note can say nothing changed. Current AD52 supports batching and delegation without removing actual costs or elapsed effects. A separate mandatory pace field, director, daily budget, manual first step or click cooldown is not a prerequisite for each chosen consumer under AD51.

Parity of hidden multipliers is distinct from promising every milestone remains reachable under every schedule choice or harsh source mode. More careful or active supported play can produce genuinely better results through real skill, preparation, timing or intervention. It need not be taxed to cap a click advantage, nor must Calm acquire an invented compensation rate. Pressure need not always buy a greater reward, a world can be dangerous without a voluntary Heat modifier, and a limitation needs actual cause rather than balancing a powerful character. An ordinary accessibility/pacing control is not automatically a new diegetic power.

Known preview/commit agreement concerns the admitted terms and actual available information. A forecast need not reveal a hidden result or guarantee an uncertain outcome. The director can resolve actual hidden world causes while its player-facing explanation remains observer-safe; requiring it to read only publicly visible facts would erase legitimate private NPC plans or conditions. Conversely, the reason line cannot leak undiscovered truth just to be complete. A stop may preserve work while still costing actual elapsed support or resources; resuming is not universally free.

A progression rung can change useful range, capacity, control, precision, reliability or available means without literally adding a new verb. A renamed number with no useful consequence is a different problem. Likewise, actions during a supported encounter are not globally forbidden by the proposed choose-before-not-during framing. Retain the worlds' real mechanisms and current compatibility direction; AD42 leaves generic human taste review optional. No pace label, return reward, director, test gate, routine, real-time clock, source rule or runtime behavior was changed by this review.
